capabilities: Render block links and embeds as inline text
Search vault blocks with @ and insert block links
Hide trailing block ids and protect them from Enter/Backspace/Delete
Apply Roam-style Up, Down and Enter cursor rules in lists
Restore cursor and scroll position when reopening a file
disambiguation: Not an outline or heading navigation panel; it changes how block references, block ids, and list cursor movement behave in the editor.
extras: Interface text is currently Chinese only. Uses an internal Obsidian interface for global search and patches how the editor opens files, so features may break after a major Obsidian update. Cursor/scroll positions are stored in device local storage and are not synced; they are tracked by line number and can shift if the file is edited elsewhere. Two features are marked experimental: task state in references and warm-up scan on open. No network requests or data collection.
problem: Obsidian block references render as blocky embeds, block ids are easy to break while editing, and list cursor movement and file reopen positions are awkward.
summary: Obsidian plugin that renders block references as inline text, adds @ block search, protects hidden block ids, and applies Roam-style list cursor behavior.
